External ALD Datasets — Preprocessing Summary
============================================================

Sources: Metabolomics Workbench ST000741, ST000742
Singh Lab / Henry Ford Health System / U. Michigan, 2017
License: CC BY 4.0  |  DOI: 10.21228/M8HH47

Data type: Untargeted LC-MS metabolomics
Tissues: Fibroblast cell culture (ST000741), Post-mortem brain (ST000742)

NOTE: Feature space mismatch with main plasma lipidomics dataset.
These datasets contain general metabolomics (~300-400 metabolites),
of which only 6-30 are lipid-like species.
Direct feature-level merging with the 1810-lipid plasma dataset
is not possible — use the *_lipids_aligned.csv files for partial
overlap, or use these datasets independently (separate encoder).

Severity label mapping:
  ST000741: 0=Healthy control, 1=Mild disease, 2=Severe disease
  ST000742 human: 0=Healthy control, 1=NLA (asymptomatic),
                  2=PLS (AMN-like), 3=PL (cerebral ALD)
  ST000742 mouse: 0=WT, 1=KO-M, 2=ALD-KO

Processed files:
  ST000741 fibroblasts: 18 samples, 659 metabolite features, labels: {0: 6, 1: 6, 2: 6}
  ST000742 human brain: 29 samples, 139 metabolite features, labels: {0: 7, 1: 7, 2: 9, 3: 6}
  ST000742 mouse brain: 9 samples, 139 metabolite features, labels: {0: 3, 1: 3, 2: 3}
